title: Gospel 444 — Revenue Bridge: Teaching Method as Sales Weapon
core_thesis: English is the mechanic, money is the mission. Gospel 444 is not just a teaching methodology — it is the competitive moat, the sales differentiation, and the scaling architecture for Natural English Training.

verbatim_quotes.quote: English is the mechanic, money is the mission.
No more neglecting real income for near future promises.
My goal is to make it so you don't need me after 1 year.
verbatim_quotes.context: Ultimate Mouse-to-Tiger close — give permission for independence, they trust you completely

verbatim_quotes.quote: I really hate how the English centers take advantage of everyone.
verbatim_quotes.context: Anti-center positioning from genuine conviction, not marketing angle

verbatim_quotes.quote: The app is programmed to teach my style without me being there.
verbatim_quotes.context: OBI as Gospel 444 at scale — carries methodology 24/7

key_concepts.name: Mouse-to-Tiger as Sales Architecture
key_concepts.definition: The same Gospel 444 teaching progression (permission to confidence to competence to mastery) applied to the sales process. Sell the way you teach.
key_concepts.evidence: Dung conversion: first message to booked session in one conversation, same day

key_concepts.name: Anti-Center Positioning
key_concepts.definition: Every Gospel 444 teaching principle mirrors as a competitive attack against English centers. Not a marketing angle — genuine conviction that makes parents feel the difference.
key_concepts.evidence: Centers force memorization vs natural acquisition, rigid textbooks vs interest-driven, inflated scores vs honest reporting, dependency vs independence

key_concepts.name: OBI as Gospel 444 at Scale
key_concepts.definition: OBI carries Gospel 444 into every hour Michael is not teaching. The 23 hours/day when Michael is not in the room, Gospel 444 still runs through OBI.
key_concepts.evidence: Chrome Extension v0.3.0 (Chat/Homework/Vocab), Galaxy Lessons active

key_concepts.name: Revenue-First Doctrine
key_concepts.definition: AI system amplifies the teaching method — it does not replace the teacher or the revenue the teacher generates. MAKE MONEY is the mission.
key_concepts.evidence: Established 2026-03-26, reinforced across all subsequent sessions

key_concepts.name: Anti-Discount Doctrine
key_concepts.definition: Zero negotiation on price. Value established BEFORE price mentioned. Maps to Gospel 444: build the experience first, then name the standard.
key_concepts.evidence: 600k/hr floor, pricing options respect autonomy (2x/wk or 1x+AI)

key_concepts.name: Findability Problem
key_concepts.definition: The gap is not conversion (sales DNA is elite) — the gap is discovery. Make the accidents happen on purpose.
key_concepts.evidence: Facebook funnel 20/20 complete, Lakeview posts ready, Google Business Profile not started

key_concepts.name: Teaching Method IS Marketing
key_concepts.definition: There is no separate marketing strategy. Gospel 444 made visible IS the content, the marketing, and the sales funnel.
key_concepts.evidence: Voice Bible codified, 18 Vietnamese posts written in neighbor tone

sales_sequence_gospel_444_parallel.gospel_444: Meet them in their natural environment
Assess where they ARE, not where you want them
Identify what is blocking natural learning
Introduce the tool that bridges sessions
Respect autonomy — they choose the path
Momentum — do not let energy dissipate

scale_architecture.phase_1_current: Michael teaches 1:1 then OBI handles daily practice. 24-40M VND/month with 5-10 students.
scale_architecture.phase_2_3: Michael teaches premium 1:1 then OBI self-paced 24/7. AI content + assessment agents. Multiple tracks.
scale_architecture.phase_4_empire: Full multi-agent content swarm. Course marketplace. B2B licensing. 50,000+ students. 9-figure VND annual.

cross_references.what: 30 tactical insights, organic funnel, revenue math
Tone and voice rules for marketing
